_doc: Acknowledged reds — vibe-ic#1025. Adjudicated by
vibe-ic-marketplace/plugins/vibe-ic/programs/gate_red_since_check.py.
A row here grants NO leniency. The hygiene suite still exits 1 for every
FAIL exactly as it did before this file existed, so there is nothing a row
can silence and no green a row can buy. The ONLY thing a row does is start
a clock that gate_red_since_check will fail on once `max_commits` is
exceeded. Adding a row is therefore taking on a deadline, never escaping
one.
Delete the row in the SAME commit that fixes the gate. A row that outlives
its truth is failed as `stale`, because a stale acknowledgement is
indistinguishable to the next reader from a live one, and it is the row
that gets believed.
FIELDS
gate         the gate's label EXACTLY as tools/ci/_gate_dispatch.sh
records it. A label that matches nothing in the record is
failed as `stale`, so a drifting label cannot go quiet.
since        the commit at which the gate went red. The clock is commits
and not wall time so that every reader of the same tree
computes the same age with no persisted run history.
max_commits  how many commits this red may survive before this file
fails the landing gate. Required — an acknowledgement with
no bound never comes due, which is the state being removed.
owner        the issue or PR that will close it.
why          why it is red, in one sentence, for the reader who finds
this file six weeks from now.
